mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment (bill_id, amount, han_amount, book_amount, product_name, edu_status, material_status, message, request_date, expired_date, yy, mm, student_id, user_code, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{billId}, #{amount}, #{hanAmount}, #{bookAmount}, #{productName}, #{eduStatus}, #{materialStatus}, #{message}, #{requestDate}, #{expiredDate}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{studentId}, #{userCode}, #{centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())

INSERT INTO erp_payment_history (bill_id, event_type, event_source, amount, description, payment_key, student_id, user_code, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{billId}, #{eventType}, #{eventSource}, #{amount}, #{description}, #{paymentKey}, #{studentId}, #{userCode}, #{centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT cf.class_key AS classKey, cf.fee AS fee, cc.class_name AS className, cc.class_type AS classType FROM erp_class_fee_map cf JOIN erp_class_code cc ON cf.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE cf.center_code = #{centerCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment_callback (bill_id, api_key, appr_pay_type, appr_card_type, appr_date, appr_issuer, appr_num, appr_price, appr_state, created) VALUES (#{bill_id}, #{apikey}, #{appr_pay_type}, #{appr_card_type}, #{appr_dt}, #{appr_issuer}, #{appr_num}, #{appr_price}, #{appr_state}, SYSDATETIME());
